channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jaren Jackson Jr | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jaren Jackson Jr from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Desmond Bane on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: Desmond Bane on Ja Morant and Jaren Jackson Jr. being at his game tonight:

“It’s special. Those are guys that I spent 5 years with… It’s a friendship that’ll last forever… I’m thankful that they pulled up to support.”

Desmond Bane on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant, Apr 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Terry on Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Terry spoke glowingly of the potential of a Jackson-Markkanen backcourt, two All-Stars that will be leading the way for the Jazz.

“We're a young team, we're rebuilding, but just made a move at the deadline to get Jaren Jackson Jr, appearing with Lauri Markkanen, which gives us one of the one of the most dominant front courts in the league,”

Jason Terry on Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr, Mar 5, 2026. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Dillon Brooks on Jaren Jackson Jr, Santi Aldama
item.description:
Damichael Cole:Dillon Brooks on when he sees Jaren Jackson Jr. and Santi Aldama guarding him:

“It’s barbecue chicken, for sure when I see those guys.… It’s always fun when I see those guys and they get on an island with me. Especially now. Show them exactly what’s going on.”

Dillon Brooks on Jaren Jackson Jr, Santi Aldama, Jan 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Drew Hill:Chet Holmgren on Jaren Jackson Jr.:

“Any time you see an injury it's thoughts and prayers, especially from someone you know has been through that and fought to the other side. It's not fun. We are seeing it a lot across the league right now.”

Chet Holmgren on Jaren Jackson Jr, Mar 5, 2025. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Alex Sarr on Anthony Davis, Rudy Gobert, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Sarr:

“I studied the whole league, really. I just see how different guys are. There are a lot of different great shot blockers. I’ve looked at AD(Anthony Davis), Jaren Jackson Jr. and Rudy Gobert clips. For me, it’s more a matter of instincts and knowing when to go for the ball and knowing when not to go.”

Alex Sarr on Anthony Davis, Rudy Gobert, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 16, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Rudy Gobert, Marcus Smart, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
“A point guard (Marcus Smart) got it over me, a center (Rudy Gobert) got it over me, a power forward (Jaren Jackson Jr.) has gotten it over me,”

Bam Adebayo on Rudy Gobert, Marcus Smart, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 10, 2024. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant, Desmond Bane
item.description:
Drew Hill:Darko Rajakovic on if it’s any easier to scout this game:

“It’s never easy to scout a team that has Ja Morant, Desmond Bane and Jaren Jackson Jr.”

Darko Rajakovic on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant, Desmond Bane, Jan 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Ja Morant on Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Drew Hill:Ja Morant on potentially playing Jaren Jackson Jr. in the ASG:

“I’m definitely setting up an action where we can meet each other at the rim. We’re going to see if I’m really him, or maybe if he’s him. Either I’m dunking on him or he’s blocking it. If I miss it don’t count”

Ja Morant on Jaren Jackson Jr, Feb 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Taylor Jenkins on the conspiracy theory about Jaren Jackson Jr.’s stats being inflated:

“Foolish. JJ is one of the best defensive players in the game. So glad to have him on our team.”

Taylor Jenkins on Jaren Jackson Jr, Jan 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Moussa Diabate on Tim Thomas, Kevin Garnett, Serge Ibaka, Pascal Siakam, Bam Adebayo, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Moussa Diabaté:

“Over the years, I’ll say a lot of Bam Adebayo, Pascal Siakam, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Kevin Garnett. Those are four players that I’ve really looked up to. I watch a little bit of everyone. Tim Thomas, I don’t know if you know him, but I watch a little bit of him. Serge Ibaka, I watch him from back when he was in OKC; that’s another big one. Just players like that – all-around big 4s and centers who are able to move their feet, guard on the perimeter, be versatile and make a two-way impact.”

Moussa Diabate on Tim Thomas, Kevin Garnett, Serge Ibaka, Pascal Siakam, Bam Adebayo, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 9, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jayson Tatum, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Tom Westerholm:Brad Stevens on Jaren Jackson Jr.:

“It sounds like he’s sort of an old soul, maybe a little bit like Tatum from a standpoint of kind of ahead of his years,and being able to play and impact the NBA game.”

Brad Stevens on Jayson Tatum, Jaren Jackson Jr, Dec 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.
